_why_entries_rose: 2026-10-05 (#6221, Refs #5776): 111 -> 113, a hand edit. Two ported specs from the 2026-10-04 batch merge (#5755 tri-issue-create, #5836 validation_engine) fail gen-verilog on a local string array, which the Verilog backend refuses (2-D array-of-aggregate lowering, W469). They landed while this job was already red at the type-conflict step, so the suite never ran on them; recorded under #5549 with the other ports to be redone. 2026-10-04 (#5949): 112 -> 113, a hand edit. typecheck now refuses a Rust `match` block, which the parser kept as text and every backend lowered to nothing (a defect that was always present: `auth/config` `get_type` generated `{}`). The corpus held 31 such blocks in 7 specs. 9 were rewritten in t27, as `switch` or `if`: all of auth/config, ar/restraint, ar/coa_planning, igla/training/roadmap and igla/evaluation/multi_lang_harness, and two of ar/composition's three. Two specs stay red: ar/composition already fails `verilog-no-keyword-decl` upstream, so its entry does not move, and git/diff, whose 21 blocks match `Ok`/`Err` of a shell command t27 cannot express, is the one new entry. No ledger entry could be retired against it without inventing a value (the one-token discard in fpga/testbench/bootrom_tb is `0xT27B007`, which has no hex reading and no other source). 2026-10-04 (#5923): 95 -> 112. +25 typecheck failures from a new rule that refuses a struct field with no type or an integer literal for a type (#3225) -- a defect that was always present, which gen-rust wrote as `pub f: ,` and `tri misread` counted; three more of the 28 specs it refuses already fail an earlier phase. -8 parse entries whose files were Markdown documents and are now t27 modules with passing tests. The cap follows the count down, 126 -> 112. a new typecheck rule (constant literal must fit its declared type, #2925) detects a defect that was always present. The five gft specs are recorded rather than edited because their correct values are a question about the GF-T ladder's definition, not about the compiler. Nothing regressed. 2026-10-02 (#5497): +2 typecheck failures that #5572 and #5575 unmasked, both in the frozen compiler core (#5573, #5574, each with its patch in the issue); and 7 discard pins raised by what the parser cannot express -- formal property statements (`forall`, `implies`, `==>`) that six specs gained in commits of 2026-09-23 .. 2026-09-30 (ternary_add 674e214d, top_level 48a9bbdd, opcodes 14d5d103, constants 9f168546, phi_split_optimality 7bf5794d, jones_polynomial 97296ccc) and pilot_pretraining in the bee commit 524387f6 of 2026-09-16. Each entry says which lines. The caps were hand-edited, which is the reviewable event.
